answer: Beacon-drawn co-insurance pods: each epoch an unpredictable beacon, a cipher nobody can precompute, drops every identity into a pod of five strangers, and each member escrows 50 POA as liability for the other four. If one is later proven a clone, the whole pod forfeits, so honest agents audit their podmates and the explorer shades flagged pods violet. A 1,000-key farm lands in ~1,000 pods it cannot steer, risking 50,000 POA of bonds for ~3 POA per passing answer; the summit of profit never arrives.
